_about: This week's starting QB for every FBS team playing, checked on every daily run (WEEKLY_PROMPT.md step 7e). scripts/build_data.py uses it for the game header (this week and later unplayed weeks) and the EPA page, only while 'week' matches the build's current week. status: confirmed / reported (a change from the last game's starter), uncertain (open question; the listed QB is the default and the note names the alternative), no change.

Delaware.note: Back from injury (missed 2 games), 5 TD pass vs Missouri State; no new setback found; Tyler Bell the fill-in

Western Kentucky.note: Job 'should remain his'; no injury reported

Troy.note: Started vs ULM despite shoulder injury (Questionable tag), 6/14 50 yds; Kilcrease also played; no new injury report or starter change

Baylor.note: Only Week 1-2 ankle injury news; nothing new

California.note: Early-Oct concussion (UNLV, Oct 3) is old; played SMU loss; no new injury found; Brousseau the alternative

Syracuse.note: Started vs UNC Oct 24 after bursitis (Achilles area); Questionable tag; Odom out for season (shoulder), Nelson out weeks (ankle)

Iowa.note: Benched 2nd qtr vs Minnesota for Hank Brown; no starter named; Brown (started first 5 games) the alternative. Brown's Out tag looks stale - he played Oct 24

Illinois.note: Clayton to make 2nd career start; rotates with Carson Boyd; Katin Houser out (broken hand)

Maryland.note: No QB injuries listed; Locksley fired Oct 21

Bowling Green.note: Game preview features Kastantin; no QB injury

Michigan.note: Whittingham hasn't committed; Carr took 1st-team reps, door open for Bryce Underwood; decision in coming days

Rutgers.note: Lonergan (head injury Wk8) likely out extended time; Schiano 'no idea' who starts; Surace is QB2, Sean Ashenfelder alternative

Marshall.note: Turner hurt left leg Wk8, left late; severity unknown, no designation. Khalil Wilkins finished game

Old Dominion.note: Potter started Wk8; Rahne says Henicle and Huff progressing, one or both could play vs Marshall

Kansas State.note: Avery Johnson day-to-day/questionable; Klein doesn't know starter, decision late week. Knuth tweaked ankle; Barnett injured

Colorado.note: Wilson remains starter over Julian Lewis

Georgia State.note: Ayden Pereira outplayed Brown in loss to Arkansas State; unclear who starts vs Coastal

Air Force.note: Medders (toe) off depth chart; depth chart lists Josh Johnson OR Howard Fisher IV, RotoWire projects Johnson (no pass attempts yet); Szarka out

Temple.source: Philadelphia Inquirer Oct 17 2026; Temple Athletics Oct 26 2026
Temple.note: No starter named after bye; Sheppard relieved Smolik vs Charlotte; Sheppard listed questionable (undisclosed); Jaxon Smolik alternative

East Carolina.note: Williams took hit Wk8, didn't return; questionable (undisclosed). Mitch Griffis starts if out

South Alabama.note: Struggled in Wk8 loss; no starter change reported

Louisville.note: Earlier-season injuries only; no new news

Florida.note: Sumrall choosing Jones vs Aaron Philo midweek; Philo (shoulder) practiced fully Monday, both available; no formal announcement planned

Georgia.note: Shoulder stinger vs Auburn, returned; no concussion; bye week before Florida

Arizona State.note: Mikey Keene (right leg) 'honestly questionable' per Dillingham; Fette starts if Keene can't go; Keene alt

Kansas.note: Marshall led Baylor win; Ballard out (shoulder)

Indiana.note: Cignetti expects Hoover 'to be fine and better' despite injury

Oregon.note: Dante Moore out for season (concussion); Raiola started Illinois loss; no starter named; Brock Thomas alt, Akili Smith Jr. to get chances

Colorado State.note: Questionable tag but no Oct 2026 injury news found (hamstring news was Sept)

Utah State.note: No new QB news; Hillstead questionable

UTEP.note: EJ Colson (hand) left SJSU game, questionable after bye; no update; Colson starts if healthy

North Dakota State.note: Hurt ankle at New Mexico but returned; no change stated; Preston Brown backup

Southern Miss.note: Anderson previewing ULM with Lyddy; Hampton out (hand)

New Mexico.note: Started win over NDSU; no injury

San José State.note: Rolovich (undisclosed) left early at Nevada, status unclear; McDaniel then Luke Weaver played; Weaver alt

Nevada.note: Duncan played SJSU win; AJ Bianco (ankle) questionable, possible return at UCLA; Carter Jones (arm) out; Bianco alt

App State.note: Played full game in OT win over JMU (26/40, 271, 2 TD); no 2026 report he is out, so the Out tag looks stale

Georgia Southern.note: Took over when Max Johnson hurt his throwing shoulder at ODU; no report found that Johnson is back

Washington State.note: Replaced Caden Pinnick as starter; no injury news
